programmes.d: When a petty officer is brutally gunned down on the freeway, Gibbs and the team discover that the officer had been living a double life.
Gibbs and the team investigate the murder of a Marine's wife that appears to have been broadcast over the Internet.
Gibbs and the team investigate when a 6-year-old boy informs NCIS his father has been kidnapped.
When the bodies of two assassins are delivered to NCIS from overseas, Tony and Ziva assume their identities undercover and engage in a sexy rendezvous at a luxury hotel in order to find their target.
In New York, the women stay with Victoria's acting school roommate, Melanie lives in the moment, Joy wants to be a Rockette, and Elka hawks her polish.
Joy falls for Bob while working undercover with him, Melanie hosts a 24-hour marathon of her radio show, and Elka decides to run against Councilman Powell.
Joy is jealous that her new boss Mitch has eyes for Melanie, Elka strategizes with her campaign manager, and Victoria awaits her possible Oscar nomination.
Victoria, Joy and Elka each have their own reasons in imploring Melanie to date a billionaire newspaper publisher, who confides in her a disturbing secret.
During a thunderstorm, Victoria is stuck with a beach bum, Melanie is irritated by her friend, Joy objects to her mother's fiance, and Elka fears a ghost.
When Elka produces a play about the women, Melanie, Joy and Victoria are livid over how they're portrayed, then meet with their actor counterparts to set them straight.
A dating consultant sabotages Mitch's chances with Joy, Victoria spends time with down-to-earth filmmaker J.J., and Elka has a campaign fundraiser.
Joy and Mitch preemptively see a couples' therapist, and Victoria's son Tony doesn't know how to come out of the closet to her as straight.
As maid of honor, Sabrina pays the price for reuniting Salem with his daughter in time for her wedding.
Brad’s witch hunting gene goes into overdrive when Sabrina comes down with Spring Fever.
The West gets even wilder when Sabrina takes the reins as town sheriff.
Cousin Amanda returns to give Sabrina a little competition in the teenage witch -and love-- department.
Choosing a college literally tears Sabrina apart when she tries too hard to make everyone happy.
